hero.subtext: ITrackZen helps companies monitor vehicles, drivers, fuel, routes, safety and fleet performance in real time, from one secure platform on web and mobile.

trust.title: Built for Africa
trust.text: Designed for long routes and mixed networks

overview_heading: Everything you need to track, protect and optimise your fleet
overview_text: From a single motorcycle to a multi-country truck fleet, ITrackZen combines GPS tracking, sensors, video and reporting so you can see what is happening and act before small problems become expensive ones.

overview.title: Real-Time GPS Tracking
overview.text: Watch every vehicle on a live map with speed, status, ignition and location history.

overview.title: Fleet Management
overview.text: A single dashboard for vehicles, drivers, maintenance, alerts and business reports.

overview.title: AI Dashcam & Video
overview.text: Front and in-cabin cameras that flag distraction, drowsiness, phone use and smoking.

overview.title: Fuel Monitoring
overview.text: Track fuel level, consumption and suspicious drops to reduce waste and theft.

overview.title: Supported Trackers
overview.text: Teltonika, Concox, Queclink, Meitrack, Ruptela and many more brands and protocols.

overview.title: Cross-Border Tracking
overview.text: Follow trucks across countries and corridors with one account and consistent reporting.

tour.heading: See the platform in action
tour.text: A quick look at what your team sees every day: road-facing video, a live fleet map, route playback, instant alerts and analytics.

tabs.label: Vehicle Camera
tabs.title: Video that explains the event
tabs.text: Front and in-cabin cameras record what happened and AI flags risky driving as it occurs.

tabs.label: Live Fleet Map
tabs.title: Every vehicle, in real time
tabs.text: Moving, idle and parked vehicles update live with geofences drawn right on the map.

tabs.label: Route History
tabs.title: Replay any trip
tabs.text: Review the exact path, stops, speed and timing of past trips to verify deliveries and find detours.

tabs.label: Smart Alerts
tabs.title: Know first, act fast
tabs.text: Overspeed, ignition, geofence, route deviation, SOS and fuel alerts reach you instantly.

tabs.label: Analytics
tabs.title: Decisions backed by data
tabs.text: Distance, fuel, driver scores and utilisation turn raw tracking into clear business reports.

steps.title: Choose your devices
steps.text: Use trackers you already own or let us recommend OBD, hardwired, 4G, motorcycle, asset or dashcam hardware.

steps.title: Install and connect
steps.text: We help configure each device so it reports securely to your ITrackZen account.

steps.title: Monitor and respond
steps.text: Track vehicles live, receive alerts, review video and control access with your team.

steps.title: Optimise with reports
steps.text: Use daily, weekly and monthly reports to cut costs, improve safety and plan better.

cta.title: Ready to see every vehicle in your fleet?
cta.text: Talk to our team about the right tracking setup for your vehicles, drivers and routes. We reply fast on email and WhatsApp.
